newsitem.title: USA: Fleetwood Enterprises Q2 prelim sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood Enterprises Q2 prelim sales rise.

text.p: Fleetwood Enterprises Inc said Wednesday that preliminary sales for its fiscal second quarter ended October 27 were $748 million, a six percent increase from $707.1 million a year earlier.
Fleetwood, which produces manufactured housing and recreational vehicles, said revenues for the fiscal first half also rose six percent, to $1.5 billion from $1.41 billion.
The company said the year-earlier revenues were restated to exclude finance revenues from Fleetwood Credit Corp, its recreational-vehicle finance subsidiary that was sold in May 1996.
The restatement reduced revenues by $11.9 million for the second quarter and by $25.7 million for the first half.
Final sales and earnings figures for the second quarter and first half will be reported in about four weeks, the company said.
